title: Passkey Reset & Role Isolation Release (v0.4.37)
message: Streamlined temporary passkey resets, complete credential vault isolation, and clean learner LRN displays.
changelog:
🔧 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.37:
• Educator Temporary Passkey: Direct single-click passkey issuance without email verification requirements.
• Vault Role Isolation: Completely separates educator passkey slips from student credential tables.
• Refined Learner Display: Removed 'LRN: Pending' labels across all student credential rows.
• Automatic Role Routing: Ensures teachers resetting credentials navigate straight to the Teacher Dashboard.
